items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Now I played with Bunk in Chicago.

ctx.x: Did you think René was a very good trumbo player?

Oh, I know he was. It was too bad he didn't do any recording them out there, and Buddy too. Buddy was on the art of Bunk. Now I played with Bunk in Chicago. Oh yeah? Yeah, Bunk, the central Bunk. The later years in the 40's now. Yeah, Bunk came up, but I could still see why they were talking about he was so great and he had taught Lil Armstrong during that time. But Bunk, every train they went there, they went to the station looking for Bunk to arrive, and he wouldn't be on that train. Finally, about the fourth…
The horn might be on another train.
